training.note: Best-of-population result from a parallel Double DQN hyperparameter sweep (lr=0.0003, epsilon_decay_transitions=2000000, batch_size=128) over the full Easy/Medium/Pro all-tracks curriculum, warm-started from the previous classic_intro.gdp

reference_evaluation.note: One episode per curriculum environment (all 30 Easy/Medium/Pro tracks), not a single-track result. Solves 7/10 Easy tracks (Intro, Slope, Crackle, Knolls, Cliff, Hole, Original) plus Medium track Spikehops; other Medium/Pro tracks are not yet finished but several show substantial partial progress.
